Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
You see smoke on the horizon. Thornfield — 10 people, 4 days in. foragers, by the look of it. They know 2 plants — 2 new to you. They've been here the whole time.

Fresh-cut stems on the south ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (Thornfield's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)
